# BACTEREMIA ASOOCIATED WITH PSEUDOMONAS

One antimicrobial is sufficient to treat pseudomonas bacteremia unless the

patient is critically ill. Identification and treatment of the source of

infection, in addition to antimicrobial therapy, is crucial for resolution of

infection. This may include removal of catheters and draining of abscesses if

present.

# Duration of therapy

Treat for a total of 7 days with source control. Most patients can rapidly

transition to an oral antibiotic. Call Infectious Diseases or Stewardship Team

for more information.

# Treatment

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h \($$\) R](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)

< OR >

[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)

# For critically ill patients or likely resistant organism, in addition to

# treatment above

[< ADD > Tobramycin 5 mg/kg IV x 1 \($\) R,O](psjizid-tobramycin-5-mg-kg-iv-once)
